claims.value: Dayhoff is a hybrid state-space Mamba and Transformer model with Mixture-of-Experts for protein sequence generation, mutation effect prediction, and motif scaffolding.
claims.evidence: The Dayhoff architecture is a hybrid of state-space Mamba layers and Transformer self-attention, interleaved with Mixture-of-Experts modules to maximize capacity while preserving efficiency.
Dayhoff is intended for broad research use on protein language modeling. The model has been used and assessed on the following capabilities: 1. Unconditional design of protein sequences
